intro: Bu kalıplar iskelet kurmana yardım eder; ezberleyip her yere aynen koyma. Examiner ezber cümleleri fark eder ve kelime puanına saymaz. Kalıbı sorunun konusuna uyarla.

sections.note: 4 paragraf: **1) Giriş** (soruyu kendi kelimelerinle yeniden yaz) **2) Overview** (2 ana eğilim, sayı yok) **3–4) Detaylar** (verileri grupla ve karşılaştır). Sonuç paragrafı gerekmez.

items.en: The line graph **illustrates / compares** how … changed between 2000 and 2020.
items.tr: Giriş: shows yerine illustrates/compares; tarih ve birimleri koru.

items.en: **Overall**, … rose considerably, **while** … remained relatively stable.
**It is clear that** … was by far the most popular …
In 2000, … stood at 48%, **compared with** only 10% in …
**rose / increased / climbed** steadily · **soared / surged** · **fell / declined / dropped** sharply · **plummeted**
a **gradual / steady / significant / dramatic** rise · a **slight** fall
items.tr: Sıfat + isim yapısı fiil tekrarını önler.

items.en: **levelled off** at … · **remained stable / unchanged** · **fluctuated** between … and … · **peaked at** …
**overtook** … in 2012 · **twice as many as** · **three times higher than** · **respectively**
**the proportion of** … · **the number of** (sayılabilir) · **the amount of** (sayılamaz)
Process: is collected → is sorted → **Once this has been done**, … → **Finally**, …
Map: **was replaced by** · **was converted into** · **has been extended** · **to the north of**

sections.note: **Giriş:** konuyu yeniden ifade et + tezini yaz (2 cümle). **Gövde 1–2:** konu cümlesi → açıklama → örnek → bağlantı. **Sonuç:** tezini ve ana nedenleri kısaca tekrarla; yeni fikir ekleme.

items.en: Opinion: **While I accept that** …, **I firmly believe that** …
Discussion: **Some argue that** … , **whereas others believe** … . **In my view**, …
Problem–Solution: **The most serious problem is** … **To tackle this**, governments **could** …
Adv–Disadv: **Although this trend has some drawbacks, its benefits are greater.**
Two-part: her soruya **ayrı paragraf**; ilk cümlede hangi soruyu cevapladığını belli et.
Ekleme: **In addition**, **Furthermore**, **What is more**, **Not only … but also**
Zıtlık: **However**, **Nevertheless**, **whereas**, **although**, **despite + isim**, **On the other hand**
Neden–sonuç: **As a result**, **Consequently**, **This means that**, **due to + isim**, **because of + isim**
Örnek: **For example**, **For instance**, **such as**, **A case in point is** …
Vurgu: **In particular**, **Notably**, **Above all**, **More importantly**
**There is considerable evidence that** …
**This is particularly true of / for** …
**plays a crucial role in** · **has a significant impact on** · **contributes to**
**address / tackle / alleviate** the problem · **raise awareness of**
**It could be argued that** … · **It is often claimed that** …

warn.bad: It is a well-known fact that … / In this day and age …
warn.why: Ezber kalıplar; examiner bunları görmezden gelir.

warn.bad: This essay will discuss both sides of the argument.
warn.good: This essay will … yerine doğrudan tezini yaz.

warn.bad: In my opinion, I think that …
warn.good: In my opinion, … / I believe that …
There are arguments on both sides.

warn.bad: don't, can't, it's, a lot of, kids, stuff
warn.good: do not, cannot, it is, a large number of, children, items
warn.why: Kısaltma ve gündelik dil akademik yazıda kullanılmaz.

warn.good: Bağlaçları paragrafın mantığına göre seç; her cümleye koyma.
warn.why: Mekanik bağlaç kullanımı Coherence puanını 6'da tutar.
